reason: A tool call to a redirecting address should return the item as before the client port; the check is on the returned data, not on internals.
String, integer and boolean query parameters reaching the service so the filtered result is correct is required OpenAPI tool behaviour.
A query value must arrive at the service unchanged, which any correct HTTP client must guarantee.
A toolset configured with a bearer credential must send it as an Authorization header; the Bearer form is the standard scheme.
